shortDescription: Go ahead. Get the Upgrade. Because LG SIGNATURE's Single Oven sleek slide-in range delivers on every level. Ready to master new techniques? Quickly Air Fry enough to feed a crowd. Air Sous Vide cooks tender meats right in the oven. Ready to impress? The elevated, Pro Range design really ups the style of your kitchen. The EasyClean® oven keeps your range looking like new. And, of course, there's performance. Discover Dynamic ProBake® Convection and powerful burners up to 23K and the flexible cooking zones to do more.

features.text: Room for the Turkey and Sides as Well
Whether you’re baking large batches of cookies or a 20-lb turkey and the sides for the holidays, this spacious 6.3 cu. ft. oven can fit it all.

When ordinary burners can’t keep pace with your on-demand dinner schedule, turn up the power with the UltraHeat™ 23K BTU dual power burner that rapidly goes to high heat to quickly boil, or turns down to a true simmer.
Dynamic ProBake Convection® uses multidirectional airflow with adjustable speeds to optimize heat distribution and accelerate cooking giving you speed, control, and superior taste.
Elevate your space with an impressive 6.8" LCD touch display that lets you activate your combination wall oven with a few simple touches. And it doesn’t just look impressive. It’s also easy to clean.
Crispy Flavor to Feed a Crowd

Air fry delivers crispy, crowd‑pleasing flavor fast with no preheating required and no extra countertop gadget needed. Simply press air fry to prepare favorites like French fries, hot wings, and more. High temperatures and a powerful convection fan work together to create the crave‑worthy crunch you love while using significantly less oil than traditional deep frying, making it a healthier alternative without sacrificing flavor or adding the guilt.
Flex Control Knobs, Designed for Life

Control and flexibility at your fingertips. The Flex Control knobs let you customize your kitchen. For an extra layer of peace of mind, this 3-step pinch, push and turn knob motion is a great option for homes with kids or pets. Simply switch the knob setting if you prefer the standard 2-step push and turn knob motion.
